stories.title: Hawarden’s new cemetery won’t be in Hawarden, councillor says
stories.summary: The site now proposed for Hawarden’s new cemetery is not in Hawarden, a Flintshire councillor has said, as the council seeks a further £325,000 for the scheme. stories.title: Councillor’s sums force Flintshire council to correct its own performance report
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has corrected figures on how quickly it answers the public’s requests for information after a councillor pointed out its sums were wrong. stories.title: Plaid Cymru accused of breaking promises to hold full Wales Covid Inquiry

stories.title: Double yellow lines proposed around Oakenholt school
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council says the lines would stop parked cars blocking junctions and a roundabout near the school.

stories.title: 200 new food businesses recorded in Flintshire in a year
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council recorded 200 new food businesses in the year to the end of March, and 29 were still waiting for a first hygiene inspection. Seven of the 29 were overdue.
